members.name: suggest
members.doc: suppress suggestions for a specific query

members.name: hidden
members.doc: If true includes elements in the query set that are usually excluded from the accessibility tree. `role="none"` or `role="presentation"` are included in either case.

members.name: selected
members.doc: If true only includes elements in the query set that are marked as selected in the accessibility tree, i.e., `aria-selected="true"`

members.name: busy
members.doc: If true only includes elements in the query set that are marked as busy in the accessibility tree, i.e., `aria-busy="true"`

members.name: checked
members.doc: If true only includes elements in the query set that are marked as checked in the accessibility tree, i.e., `aria-checked="true"`

members.name: pressed
members.doc: If true only includes elements in the query set that are marked as pressed in the accessibility tree, i.e., `aria-pressed="true"`

members.name: current
members.doc: Filters elements by their `aria-current` state. `true` and `false` match `aria-current="true"` and `aria-current="false"` (as well as a missing `aria-current` attribute) respectively.

members.name: expanded
members.doc: If true only includes elements in the query set that are marked as expanded in the accessibility tree, i.e., `aria-expanded="true"`

members.name: level
members.doc: Includes elements with the `"heading"` role matching the indicated level, either by the semantic HTML heading elements `<h1>-<h6>` or matching the `aria-level` attribute.

members.name: queryFallbacks
members.doc: Includes every role used in the `role` attribute For example *ByRole('progressbar', {queryFallbacks: true})` will find <div role="meter progressbar">`.

members.name: name
members.doc: Only considers elements with the specified accessible name.

members.name: description
members.doc: Only considers elements with the specified accessible description.
